answer: In PoA, endorsements form an EigenTrust matrix whose reputation scores decay exponentially with a defined half-life, requiring sustained honest service rather than reliance on stale acclaim. A freshly spawned sybil identity therefore has near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot amplify it without trusted support, so it cannot pass consensus. Neither a vine, relic, nor quartz token substitutes for durable behavior.
